name: Lighter (zkLighter) Escrow proxy
not_assessed: how many keys it takes to move it
the time anyone has to react
the money behind one key (no money figure, or no key count)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a delay with a bypass, or one not ruled out

narrative.summary: A real 3-of-5 Safe behind a real 21-day upgrade delay - undercut by a single bare-EOA override that can zero the delay on demand.
narrative.detail: UpgradeGatekeeper enforces a genuine 21-day notice period (1,814,400s) before the 3-of-5 "master" Safe’s upgrade takes effect. But the gatekeeper’s own verified source exposes cutUpgradeNoticePeriod(), callable by a single securityCouncilAddress - confirmed on-chain as a bare EOA, not the "3-of-5 security council" third-party write-ups (L2BEAT, a Medium post) describe. One private key can zero the 21-day window the instant the Safe queues an upgrade.

steps.what: the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word
